# Souschef

Souschef is a free recipe keeper for saving recipes from websites, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, photos, and text. Cook, shop, organize, and journal for free. Plus adds unlimited imports.

## Is Souschef free?

Yes. All cooking and organization tools are free. Free users get 5 saved recipe imports per rolling 7 days. Souschef Plus is optional and adds unlimited imports.

Cooking Mode, grocery lists, meal planning, cooking journal, collections, search, editing, and sharing are free.

## What does Souschef Plus include?

Souschef Plus includes unlimited recipe imports. It does not unlock separate cooking tools; those are free.

Souschef Plus gives you unlimited recipe imports. All cooking and organization tools are free.

There is no ad-based Plus benefit. Souschef Plus does not remove ads.

## Free import allowance

Free users can save 5 imported recipes per rolling 7 days.

Free plan includes 5 saved recipe imports per rolling 7 days.

An import counts when you tap Save. Previewing a recipe and leaving without saving does not count. Failed or unsupported imports do not count. Editing a recipe you already saved does not count.

The allowance uses a rolling 7-day window. Each saved import frees a slot 7 days later. It is not a calendar-week reset.

## What happens after the limit?

You can still view, cook, edit, organize, and use existing saved recipes. You just need to wait for imports to refresh or upgrade to Plus for unlimited imports.

Existing saved recipes remain available even after you hit the limit.

## Can I still use saved recipes if I do not pay?

Yes. Your saved recipes and cooking tools remain available.

## Imports

Imports run in the background. You can keep browsing and Souschef will notify you when the recipe is ready.

This applies to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other supported imports.

## Web

View shared recipe lists on the web. Share recipe lists with a web link.

On the web, someone can view a shared recipe, adjust servings, and switch measurement systems. Shared shopping lists and collections can be opened from a link.

Importing, cooking, and organizing happen in the iOS and Android apps. The web experience is for viewing shared recipe lists.

## Platforms

- iPhone and iPad: App Store
- Android phones and tablets: Google Play
